title: Contractor Bid Evaluation

blueprintSignals.name: Scope gap
blueprintSignals.definition: number of bill-of-quantities items missing or priced at zero
blueprintSignals.asOfRule: Parsing errors in the bid documents, so check by hand

blueprintSignals.name: Past overrun rate
blueprintSignals.definition: average percentage cost overrun of the contractor's last ten projects
blueprintSignals.asOfRule: Data are patchy and project types differ

blueprintSignals.name: Bid outlier
blueprintSignals.definition: z-score of the bid compared with the other bids and the estimate
blueprintSignals.asOfRule: Few bids make the z-score unstable, so use the estimate as well

blueprintSignals.name: Capacity
blueprintSignals.definition: the contractor's current workload relative to capacity

label: For "Contractor Bid Evaluation": Compare contractor bids on price, scope coverage, risk and track record to recommend a shortlist. Define the label exactly as in milestone M1: what counts as a positive or a correct outcome, and when it becomes known. Design around this trap first: Data only on winners, since the performance of unsuccessful bidders is never observed.
